title: Observation
description: One measured quantity, at one valid time, from one Instrument, via one Source. Bitemporal by construction (ADR-0004).

source_id.description: Channel of acquisition. Distinct from instrument_id: a Source is how data was obtained, an Instrument is what measured it (ADR-0003).

quantity.description: What was measured, in the instrument's own terms. Deliberately not an enumeration: the kernel and contracts carry no domain vocabulary (ADR-0026).

unit.description: Unit of `value`. Required even when dimensionless, so a reader never infers it.

valid_time.description: When the phenomenon occurred. Always known (ADR-0004).

ingest_time.description: When this system learned it. null means exactly one thing: unknown, predates bitemporal capture (ADR-0022, L-11). Never fabricated, never defaulted, never inferred. Required as a field so that absence cannot be confused with unknown.

value.description: null means observed to be absent. Never imputed, never zero-filled: zero is a valid measurement (ADR-0017, L-07).

quality_flags.description: Instrument-declared quality conditions. Present flags are problems.

source_digest.description: Digest of the raw artifact this row was parsed from. Provenance is a column, not a document.
